title: PsyDrift: Healthy-Reference Latent Diffusion for Anomaly Scoring in Autism Spectrum Disorder
abstract: arXiv:2611.30050v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Individual heterogeneity and acquisition-site variability complicate neuroimaging-based characterization of autism spectrum disorder (ASD). We propose PsyDrift, combining ASD/healthy-control-supervised functional-connectivity representations with healthy-reference latent diffusion. An encoder produces 128-dimensional representations, and a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) learns exclusively from healthy training latents. Distance from a diffusion-denoised reconstruction provides a continuous deviation score. We evaluate 1,102 subjects from all 20 ABIDE-I sites using five-seed leave-one-site-out cross-validation. The classifier and DDPM achieve mean-site AUROCs of $0.798 \pm 0.003$ and $0.718 \pm 0.013$, respectively; uncertainties denote seed standard deviations. Matched healthy-reference scorers on the same representation achieve 0.68-0.71; the statistical significance of diffusion's modest numerical advantage remains unes

translated_title: PsyDrift：用于自闭症谱系障碍异常评分的健康参照潜在扩散模型
translated_abstract: 个体异质性和采集站点变异性使基于神经影像学的自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）表征变得复杂。我们提出了PsyDrift，将ASD/健康对照监督训练的功能连接表征与健康参照潜在扩散相结合。编码器生成128维表征，去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）仅从健康训练潜变量中学习。与扩散去噪重建之间的距离提供了一个连续的偏离分数。我们使用五种随机种子的留一站点交叉验证，评估了来自ABIDE-I全部20个站点的1,102名受试者。分类器和DDPM分别达到平均站点AUROC为0.798±0.003和0.718±0.013；不确定度表示种子标准差。在相同表征上匹配的健康参照评分器达到0.68-0.71；扩散模型的适度数值优势的统计显著性仍未确立（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: PsyDrift通过仅从健康对照数据学习的潜在扩散模型，将功能连接表征与去噪重建的偏离转化为连续异常评分，在ABIDE-I全部20个站点跨站点验证中实现自闭症检测平均AUROC达0.798。
en_tdlr: PsyDrift combines supervised functional-connectivity representations with a healthy-reference latent diffusion model to generate continuous anomaly scores for autism spectrum disorder, achieving a mean-site AUROC of 0.798 across all 20 ABIDE-I sites via leave-one-site-out validation.
